sections.heading: Subramanian Swamy — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Subramanian Swamy was born on 15 September 1939 in Mylapore, and holds citizenship of India, Dominion of India and British Raj.
His listed education includes Hindu College, University of Delhi, Harvard University, Indian Statistical Institute and Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
He is recorded as speaking Tamil.

sections.heading: Subramanian Swamy — Career and Professional Work
paras: Subramanian Swamy works primarily as an economist, politician and author, with Harvard University listed among his employers.

He has held the following offices: Minister of Commerce and Industry (1990–1991), Member of the Lok Sabha, member of Rajya Sabha and Member of the 7th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
